projects.name: Home server
projects.description: Set up an old office PC running Debian to host a family photo library, media server, and ad-blocking DNS resolver, each isolated in its own container image and started from one compose file. Configured Caddy as a reverse proxy with automatic TLS certificates. Wrote a nightly cron job shell script to back up photos to an external disk and object storage, with Telegram failure notifications. Set up Grafana dashboards fed by node exporters to monitor CPU, memory, disk, and temperature, with alerts when disk usage passes 85%.
